info.title: devicebasedauth.org API
info.description: Revocable, device-bound credentials. Prepaid, no subscription; prices in integer micro-dollars. Credential format: https://github.com/curtcox/device-based-auth/blob/main/spec/credential.md

get.summary: Service health and deployed commit.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

get.summary: Issuer public keys (JWKS).

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

get.summary: OpenID Connect discovery document.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

get.summary: The CA certificates (PEM) that sign device client certificates, one per issuer key. Add them to your mTLS trust store.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

get.summary: A signed status list (IETF Token Status List). Bit idx = 1 means revoked.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

get.summary: Public configuration and prices.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

get.summary: Price of an operation (op = issue, renew, decision, read, token, login, audience).

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

post.summary: Decode and check a credential; optionally evaluate an action. Free.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

post.summary: Start an enrollment with a request JWS (typ dba-enroll+jwt) signed by the new device key. Returns the approval URL and a poll URL. Free; nothing is stored.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

request.description: JWS, header {typ:"dba-enroll+jwt", alg:"ES256", jwk}, payload {iat, aud[], grants[], device{name,kind,key_protection}, lifetime_seconds?, return_origin?, attestation?{format:"android-key", challenge, x5c[] (base64 DER, leaf first)}}.

post.summary: Describe a pending enrollment ticket for the approval page. Free.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

request.description: The enr_… ticket from the approval URL fragment.

post.summary: A challenge for Android Key Attestation, valid 10 minutes: generate the key with setAttestationChallenge(challenge as ASCII bytes), then add attestation {format:"android-key", challenge, x5c[]} to the enrollment request. Free; stateless.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

get.summary: Poll an enrollment until it is approved, denied or expired.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

post.summary: Approve an enrollment (optionally narrowing grants) and issue the credential. Charges the issue price.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

post.summary: Deny an enrollment.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

post.summary: Enroll with an enrollment token instead of a per-device approval: body {request (the dba-enroll+jwt; aud and grants may be left out or narrow the token's), enrollment_token}. Charges the issue price to the token's account.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

get.summary: Enrollment tokens (dbae_…): a pre-approved template (aud, grants, lifetime_seconds) for up to max_uses devices (1–10000) until expires_in_days (default 7, ≤ 90). The secret is shown once. Not available to delegating devices.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

get.description: Requires scope `credentials:issue` (API key), a signed-in session, or a device credential with `dba:credentials:issue`.

post.summary: Enrollment tokens (dbae_…): a pre-approved template (aud, grants, lifetime_seconds) for up to max_uses devices (1–10000) until expires_in_days (default 7, ≤ 90). The secret is shown once. Not available to delegating devices.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

post.description: Requires scope `credentials:issue` (API key), a signed-in session, or a device credential with `dba:credentials:issue`.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

delete.description: Requires scope `credentials:issue` (API key), a signed-in session, or a device credential with `dba:credentials:issue`.

get.summary: Budget guards: max_issues_per_day (default 500) and max_renewals_per_credential_per_month (default null, no cap). PATCH changes the members given; dashboard only.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

post.summary: Issue a credential for a public key you hold (API keys, sessions, or devices delegating narrower grants). Charges the issue price.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

post.description: Requires scope `credentials:issue` (API key), a signed-in session, or a device credential with `dba:credentials:issue`.

get.description: Requires scope `credentials:read` (API key), a signed-in session, or a device credential with `dba:credentials:read`.

delete.summary: Revoke a credential (free, immediate online; status lists within a minute).

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

delete.description: Requires scope `credentials:revoke` (API key), a signed-in session, or a device credential with `dba:credentials:revoke`.

get.summary: Online authorization decisions for a credential (kept 90 days).

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

get.description: Requires scope `credentials:read` (API key), a signed-in session, or a device credential with `dba:credentials:read`.

post.summary: Renew the presented credential (same key), or rotate to a new key with new_key_proof. Device credential + DPoP. Also accepts a credential signed by a withdrawn issuer key if it is exactly the one stored; that renewal is free and answers recovered: true.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

new_key_proof.description: Optional, for rotation: JWS typ dba-rotate+jwt over {cid, iat}, signed by the new key, its jwk in the header.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

post.description: Requires scope `credentials:revoke` (API key), a signed-in session, or a device credential with `dba:credentials:revoke`.

post.summary: Revoke everything (optionally one audience). Body {"confirm":"revoke-all"}.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

post.description: Requires scope `credentials:revoke` (API key), a signed-in session, or a device credential with `dba:credentials:revoke`.

post.summary: A device revokes the credential it presents.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

post.summary: Exchange the presented device credential for a ≤10-minute bearer access token for one audience. Charges the token price.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

post.summary: An X.509 client certificate (PEM) for the presenting device key, for mTLS (e.g. Cloudflare API Shield): CN = device id, subjectAltName URIs for device, credential and account, clientAuth only. lifetime_seconds 300–86400 (default 3600), never past the credential; mTLS cannot see revocation. Charges the token price.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

post.summary: Online authorization decision for an audience you own: revocation, usage limits, step-up, decision log. Charges the decision price.

200.description: Success. Every JSON response includes cost_microdollars.

post.description: Requires scope `authorize` (API key), a signed-in session, or a device credential with `dba:authorize`.

proof.description: The DPoP proof the device sent you (required for device credentials).
